reforms.description: The tax reform introduced significant changes to corporate taxation, reducing marginal statutory tax rates and simplifying the tax system, which is expected to spur greater investment. Additionally, the establishment of a national innovation office aims to enhance coherence and continuity in the implementation of the national innovation strategy.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax reform is designed to incentivize investment, while the national innovation office aims to streamline innovation efforts, both of which are expected to enhance economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Both reforms have been implemented as part of the national strategy.
reforms.importance_rationale: Both reforms represent significant structural changes in the innovation and taxation landscape.
reforms.source_quote: The main thrust of the reforms reduced marginal statutory tax rates for personal and corporate income, which combined with simplification will reduce distortions embedded in the tax system and spur greater investment.

reforms.description: The Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act of 2014 introduced reforms to assist job seekers by better matching them to growing sectors, aiming to build regional partnerships among employers, education and training providers, and public stakeholders.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The act aims to enhance workforce skills and align them with market needs, which supports economic growth through improved employment outcomes.
reforms.status_evidence: The act has been fully implemented to assist job seekers.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant change in workforce development policy.
reforms.source_quote: The Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act of 2014 introduced reforms to assisting job seekers by better matching them to growing sectors.

reforms.description: The government is considering reforms to the government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs) Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to reduce their risks and improve housing finance stability, including proposals to privatize the GSEs and subject them to the same regulations as other mortgage-backed security issuers.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The impact of these proposed reforms on economic growth is uncertain as they may stabilize housing finance but could also introduce risks associated with privatization.
reforms.status_evidence: The government is currently considering these reforms.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform is significant but not as transformative as the other reforms.
reforms.source_quote: The last Economic Survey recommended leaving the securitisation of mortgages to the private sector.
